observations: Five questions ask about nonstudents or public visitors using different equipment or services.

Draft general visitor statement permits general studio services, but does not individually establish every equipment item, live availability, effective date, and authority. English text is agent translated.
additional_observations: All five source-only answers return external visitor policy with unconfirmed validity disclosure.
A non-student is not necessarily an external visitor; candidate nonetheless returns the external visitor policy for the generic non-student question.
An explicit PSU staff who is not a student question instead returned a staff directory and an unfulfilled request. These are observed source-only gaps; cause and safe correction need investigation.
